title: 第十一章 超青藏高原61第十一章 超青藏高原60
lines: 五十三、开心之村猛风战神与光影战神同时降临在荒原之上。这是两尊合体战神首次并肩立于战场——猛风战神以狼王猛风为底座，地震龙与大象青牛合体附加其上，超级帝龙之剑在烈日下泛着四色光芒；光影战神以光影冰企为底座，金鹏的巨翅在后背展开，冰蓝与金色交织成复合装甲。
两尊战神并肩而立，赤红与冰蓝两色光纹在荒原上交织蔓延。天空中三道传送阵的光芒先后亮起。
冰白色的天白电阵纹、暗金色的莫星白瑶阵纹、银蓝色的锋珞阵纹——三名干部各自派出了第五位正式手下。
天白电的第五位正式手下从冰白光芒中走出，身着冰白战甲，背后展开十四片冰晶光翼，机甲名为寒星。
莫星白瑶的第五位正式手下从暗金光芒中走出，身着暗金战甲，背后展开十六片暗金光翼，机甲名为星尘。
锋珞的第五位正式手下从银蓝光芒中走出，身着银蓝战甲，背后展开十八片银蓝光翼，机甲名为霜尘。
三人先后抬起武器，光翼在荒原上空各自展开。寒星率先发起攻击。她双刀交叉，十四片冰晶光翼同时激活，十四道冰白光束从光翼中射出，在空中交织成密集的光网，朝猛风战神笼罩而下。
猛风战神将超级帝龙之剑横在身前，四色光芒在剑身上同时亮起。黄雪婧与杨欣颖在同步空间中同时抬起手臂——超级帝龙斩。
超级帝龙之剑全力劈落，四色光刃从剑身上脱离而出，化为一道弧形的能量斩击，正面切入冰白光网。
光网在四色斩击下寸寸碎裂，寒星侧身闪避，左侧六片光翼被斩击余波击中，能量发射器出现短暂延迟。
猛风战神不给她调整的机会，超级帝龙之剑再次劈落，一剑斩断寒星右侧剩余光翼的能量共振节点。
十四片光翼全部失效，寒星从空中坠落，单膝跪地。
“天白电大人会继续派新的正式手下。正式手下无穷无尽。”寒星低声说道。
黑魔弹王的传送阵启动，冰白光芒将她吞没。星尘紧接着出手。她弯刀交叉，十六片暗金光翼同时激活，十六道暗金弯月光刃从光翼中脱离而出，旋转着斩向光影战神。
光影战神金翅一振腾空而起，暗金弯月光刃在光影战神离地的瞬间打在空地上。
唐琼凯在同步空间中握紧双拳，天地光影剑在掌心凝聚——剑身上冰蓝冰晶与金色光芒交织流转。
光影战神从空中俯冲而下，天地光影剑全力劈落。星尘举刀格挡，十六片光翼在冲击波中同时向后弯折。
帝羽飞舞——金翅上的每一根飞羽同时脱离，在空中化为数十只金色光羽，精准地切入星尘每一片光翼的能量共振节点。
十六片光翼全部被光羽撕裂，星尘从空中坠落，单膝跪地。
“莫星白瑶大人的正式手下无穷无尽。”星尘低声说道。黑魔弹王的传送阵启动，暗金光芒将她吞没。
霜尘最后出手。她弯刀交叉，十八片银蓝光翼同时激活，十八道银蓝光束从光翼中射出，在空中交织成密集的弹幕。
光影战神将金翅在身前合拢——帝羽守护模式。双重护盾将银蓝光束全部弹开。
能量冲击波消散的瞬间，光影战神双翼猛地展开，天地光影剑高高举起，金翅上的所有飞羽同时亮起，冰企鹅拳套表面的冰晶能量层全部点亮——光影镭星射光。
巨型光束贯穿了霜尘的十八片光翼阵列，十八片光翼全部碎裂。霜尘从空中坠落，单膝跪地。
“锋珞大人的正式手下无穷无尽——∞。”霜尘低声说道。黑魔弹王的传送阵启动，银蓝光芒将她吞没。
荒原上恢复了宁静。三位干部的第五位正式手下已被击败，光翼碎片散落在荒原各处。
猛风战神与光影战神收回武器，两尊合体战神并肩立于战场之上。从第一位正式手下到第五位正式手下，三位干部的正式手下无穷无尽，他们还会继续派新的正式手下。
但猛风战神与光影战神已同时降临，合体战神的时代已经到来。离开战场后，四位旅人沿荒原边缘走了约半日。
前方的地势渐次平缓，一片开阔的谷地铺展在眼前。谷地中央坐落着一座小镇，建筑以木材与石料搭建，风格简洁朴素。
镇口立着一块木牌，牌上刻着
“开心之村”三个字，字体端正有力。村中往来的身影与人类别无二致——没有兽耳，没有兽尾，没有头人族，没有超兽族。
全是纯人类。但他们的脸上没有笑容。
“哞，纯人类。”胡伟的大熊猫耳朵在微风中轻轻转动，
“没有中华血脉。这座村庄不是兽人族的地界。”四人刚走近镇口，一个年轻男子迎了上来。
他穿着简洁的布衣，面容清秀，黑色的短发垂在额前。他的五官与中华血脉的人类别无二致，但全息界面在唐琼凯视觉中自动弹出检测结果——无中华血脉。
他是纯人类，名字是汉化过来的风格。
“远道而来的客人，我是雷诺星·彩云。”他的声音温和有礼，但语气中透着一股难以掩饰的疲惫，
“开心之村很久没有外来者了。你们来得不巧——我们正在度过一段艰难的时光。”黄雪婧看着雷诺星·彩云那双疲惫却仍保持礼貌的眼睛，问道：“发生了什么事？”
“开心之环丢失了。”雷诺星·彩云说，
“我们依赖开心之环让村民们开开心心。它不是武器，不是工具——它只是一个能让人开心的东西。现在它不见了，谁也开心不起来。没有开心之环，我们就只是普通的纯人类而已。”他引着四人穿过村中街道。
村民们各自忙碌着，但所有人的脸上都带着相同的疲惫。不是悲伤，不是愤怒——只是开心不起来。
content_en:
Fifty-three, Happy Village. The fierce wind war god and the light and shadow war god descended on the wasteland at the same time. This is the first time that two combined war gods stand side by side on the battlefield - the fierce wind war god uses the wolf king fierce wind as the base, the earthquake dragon and the elephant green bull are combined on top, the super emperor dragon sword glows with four colors of light under the scorching sun; the light and shadow war god uses the light and shadow ice enterprise as the base, the giant wings of the golden roc are spread out on the back, and ice blue and gold are intertwined to form a composite armor.
The two gods of war stood side by side, and red and ice blue light patterns intertwined and spread across the wasteland. The lights of three teleportation arrays in the sky lit up one after another.
The ice-white Tianbai Lightning Formation, the dark gold Mo Xing Baiyao Formation, and the silver-blue Fengluo Formation—the three cadres each sent their fifth official subordinate.
The fifth official subordinate of Tianbai Dian walked out of the ice-white light, wearing an ice-white battle armor, with fourteen ice crystal light wings spread out behind his back. The mecha was named Hanxing.
Mo Xing Bai Yao's fifth official subordinate walked out of the dark gold light, wearing a dark gold battle armor, with sixteen wings of dark gold light spread out from behind. The mecha was named Stardust.
Fengluo's fifth official subordinate walked out of the silver-blue light, wearing a silver-blue battle armor with eighteen silver-blue light wings spread out behind his back. The mecha was named Shuangchen.
The three of them raised their weapons one after another, and their wings of light spread out over the wasteland. Hanxing was the first to attack. She crossed her swords, and fourteen ice crystal light wings were activated at the same time. Fourteen ice-white beams of light shot out from the light wings, intertwining into a dense network of light in the air, and shrouding the fierce wind God of War.
The fierce wind war god held the Super Emperor Dragon Sword horizontally in front of him, and four colors of light lit up at the same time on the sword. Huang Xuejing and Yang Xinying raised their arms at the same time in the synchronized space - Super Emperor Dragon Slash.
The Super Emperor Dragon Sword fell with all its strength, and the four-color light blade detached from the sword and turned into an arc-shaped energy slash, cutting into the ice-white light network head-on.
The light net was shattered inch by inch under the four-color slash. Han Xing dodged sideways, and the six light wings on the left were hit by the aftermath of the slash, causing a brief delay in the energy transmitter.
The fierce wind war god did not give her a chance to adjust, and the Super Emperor Dragon Sword fell again, cutting off the energy resonance node of the remaining light wing on the right side of Han Xing with one sword.
All fourteen light wings failed, Han Xing fell from the sky and knelt down on one knee.
"Sir Tianbaidian will continue to send new formal subordinates. There are endless formal subordinates." Han Xing whispered.
The Dark Magic Bullet King's teleportation array was activated, and the ice-white light engulfed her. Stardust took action immediately. She crossed her scimitars, and sixteen dark gold light wings were activated at the same time. Sixteen dark gold crescent moon light blades separated from the light wings, spinning towards the God of Light and Shadow.
The golden wings of the God of Light and Shadow flew into the air, and the dark gold crescent moon blade hit the open space the moment the God of Light and Shadow left the ground.
Tang Qiongkai clenched his fists in the synchronized space, and the light and shadow sword of heaven and earth condensed in his palms - the ice blue ice crystals and golden light on the sword were intertwined and flowing.
The God of Light and Shadow swooped down from the sky, and the light and shadow sword of heaven and earth struck down with all its strength. Stardust raised his sword to block, and the sixteen light wings bent backwards simultaneously in the shock wave.
The imperial feathers fly - every flying feather on the golden wings detaches at the same time, turning into dozens of golden light feathers in the air, accurately cutting into the energy resonance nodes of each light wing in Stardust.
All sixteen light wings were torn apart by the light feathers. Stardust fell from the sky and knelt down on one knee.
"Lord Mo Xing Baiyao has endless official subordinates." Xingchen whispered. The Dark Magic Bullet King's teleportation array was activated, and the dark golden light engulfed her.
Shuangchen finally took action. She crossed her scimitars and activated her eighteen silver-blue light wings at the same time. Eighteen silver-blue beams of light shot out from the light wings, intertwining into a dense barrage in the air.
The God of Light and Shadow folds his golden wings in front of him - Emperor Feather Guardian Mode. The double shields deflected all the silver and blue beams.
The moment the energy shock wave dissipated, the wings of the Light and Shadow God of War suddenly spread out, the Heaven and Earth Light and Shadow Sword was raised high, all the flying feathers on the golden wings lit up at the same time, and the ice crystal energy layer on the surface of the Ice Penguin Gloves all lit up - the light and shadow radium star shot out.
The giant beam penetrated Shuangchen's eighteen light wings array, and all eighteen light wings shattered. Shuangchen fell from the air and knelt down on one knee.
"Lord Fengluo's formal subordinates are endless——∞." Shuangchen whispered. The Black Magic Bullet King's teleportation array was activated, and the silver-blue light engulfed her.
Tranquility returned to the wasteland. The fifth official henchman of the three cadres has been defeated, and fragments of the Lightwing are scattered across the wasteland.
The fierce wind war god and the light and shadow war god retracted their weapons, and the two combined war gods stood side by side on the battlefield. From the first official subordinate to the fifth official subordinate, the three cadres have endless official subordinates, and they will continue to send new official subordinates.
But the fierce wind war god and the light and shadow war god have arrived at the same time, and the era of the combined war god has arrived. After leaving the battlefield, the four travelers walked along the edge of the wilderness for about half a day.
The terrain ahead gradually leveled off, and an open valley spread out in front of us. There is a small town in the center of the valley. The buildings are made of wood and stone, with a simple and plain style.
There is a wooden sign at the entrance of the town, on which is engraved
The three words "Happy Village" are written in neat and powerful fonts. The figures coming and going in the village are the same as human beings - no animal ears, no animal tails, no head-humans, no super-orcs.
All purely human. But there was no smile on their faces.
"Moo, pure human." Hu Wei's giant panda ears turned gently in the breeze,
"There is no Chinese bloodline. This village is not the territory of the orcs." As the four of them approached the entrance of the town, a young man came up to them.
He was wearing simple cloth clothes, with a handsome face and short black hair hanging in front of his forehead. His facial features were the same as those of people with Chinese bloodline, but the holographic interface automatically popped up the detection result in Tang Qiongkai's vision - no Chinese bloodline.
He is a pure human being, and his name is a Chinese version.
"Guest from afar, I am Reno Xing Caiyun." His voice was gentle and polite, but there was an unconcealable exhaustion in his tone.
"There have been no outsiders in Happy Village for a long time. You are here at a bad time - we are going through a difficult time." Huang Xuejing looked at Renault Star Caiyun's tired but still polite eyes and asked: "What happened?"
"The ring of happiness is lost." Raynor Star Caiyun said,
"We rely on the Happy Ring to make the villagers happy. It's not a weapon, not a tool - it's just a thing that makes people happy. Now that it's gone, no one can be happy. Without the Happy Ring, we are just ordinary pure humans." He led the four of them through the streets of the village.
The villagers were busy, but all of them had the same tiredness on their faces. Not sad, not angry - just not happy.
